home.title: David Herrera - Applied AI Engineer in Mexico City
home.description: Applied AI Engineer in Mexico City. I build RAG and MCP systems on top of the data companies already have, with .NET, Python and Azure.

notes.title: Notes - David Herrera
notes.description: Technical notes on RAG, MCP and corporate data.

intro.lead: The hard part is almost never the model. I like building crazy ideas and making them survive production.

bio.paragraph1: I started out building WordPress sites and managing traditional hosting. Today I design and ship systems with applied AI.
bio.paragraph2: I work across the whole stack, but my job right now is RAG, MCP and MLOps over corporate data: databases nobody documented, scanned PDFs, spreadsheets with fifteen tabs.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: This site. Astro, hand-written CSS and TypeScript, built from scratch. It's on its fifth version.

connie.title: Connie
connie.description: You ask the company's databases, PDFs and spreadsheets in plain language, and it answers citing where each figure came from. Multi-client and multi-source, with enterprise auth.

handheld.title: HandHeld RFID
handheld.description: Android app with a Zebra RFID reader. Inventory went from taking weeks (or never happening) to being done walking the client's warehouse.

trace.title: Automotive Traceability
trace.description: A WinForms desktop app for the shop floor. Every part gets logged as it passes the stations on the assembly line.

appliedai.title: Applied AI Engineer
appliedai.summary: I bring AI into the team's internal processes and into the financial software the consultancy builds for its clients.

architect.title: AI Solutions Architect
architect.summary: Connie, from zero to production: I designed the RAG platform and wrote 80% of the system, which three of the consultancy's clients now use daily. Also MCP servers over the internal data sources and MLOps practices for the team.

fullstack.title: Fullstack Developer
fullstack.summary: Desktop and web apps in .NET and Python for the shop floor and operations, databases on SQL Server and PostgreSQL, and an Android app with an RFID reader for field inventory.

junior.title: Junior Fullstack Developer
junior.summary: Web modules, internal APIs and database maintenance.

webdev.title: Junior Web Developer
webdev.summary: Sites and support on WordPress, Joomla and OpenCart, plus hosting, certificate and domain administration.

speaking.title: Talks
speaking.text: I give talks on generative AI, RAG and MLOps, with systems that are already in production and their numbers. Around a hundred people per session, at Data Day 2025, EGADE Business School, UPVM Tultitlán and TESCo.

tesco.institution: Higher Studies Institute of Coacalco (TESCo) - TecNM

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: If you've got an idea, or you just want to say hi, write me. I usually reply the same day, on Mexico City time.
